messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to publish stitch-3b (fp16 -> q4_0) to catalog alias `stitch` tomorrow 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC. Quiet window 02:00–03:00. Who can own deploy + smoke?

aj: I can do the deploy, but only if someone runs the smoke tests (token usage & latency checks). @priya can you run smoke?

priya: I can take smoke verification. I'll run probe + a few sample prompts. Plan to run at 02:05 UTC.

maria: thx. aj you'll kick the rollout with canary fraction 5% then 100% after 10m if metrics look ok. Rollback plan is immediate alias swap to `stitch@v12` if error rate > 2% or p50 latency regresses >50ms.

aj: Got it. Deploy steps I'm using:
```bash
# push artifact
cli catalog publish --model-path gs://redwood-models/stitch-3b/q4_0 --alias stitch --version v13 --canary 0.05
# monitor
cli catalog watch --alias stitch --metric error_rate,latency --window 10m
```

deploy-bot: Release created: catalog-release/2026-05-12-stitch-v13 (id: rr_4500000123)

priya: Smoke checklist I'll run:
- 10 prompt latency samples (range)
- 100 chat completions at 32 tokens
- sanity diff against v12 with prompt set `stitch-smoke-2026` (a few handpicked asserts)

lia: I'll scope infra readiness — reserved slot on ded pool A confirmed. No GPU preemption expected.

tom: quick CR ping @aj — small change to the batch config in the deploy script, lgtm but do you want me to approve? :white_check_mark:

aj: please approve and I'll proceed. Also tagging @eng-sre for visibility.

eng-sre-bot: Notifying oncall: pager -> @sam. If SLO breaches, run rollback script:
```bash
cli catalog alias-swap --alias stitch --version v12
```

sam: I'll be on call during the window. I'll watch error_rate and p50 latency. If anything, I'll coordinate rollback.

priya: smoke done at 02:12 UTC — p50=84ms, error_rate=0.3%, outputs check PASS vs v12 for prompts X,Y,Z. Posting logs: https://logs.redwood/example/rr_4500000123

aj: canary -> 100% at 02:20 UTC. Observing a tiny uplift in p50 (+18ms) within threshold. No errors.

maria: great. Leaving note to pin model alias to v13 after 24h stable: `catalog pin stitch v13`

aj: done, alias is pinned with retention policy 30d.

priya: final smoke summary: all good. Closing thread, thanks :tada:

maria: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
